content: A man is what he thinks about all day long.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Your habitual stream of thought gradually crystallizes into your character, decisions, relationships, and physical destiny.
practicalInsight: Observe where your mind wanders during idle moments today, and gently steer it toward noble, constructive thoughts.
reflectionPrompt: What have your thoughts been predominantly dwelling on over the past twenty-four hours?
